message.guildmark.heist_begin: %s is in %s. Get in, take it, and get out unseen.
message.guildmark.heist_alarm: The alarm is raised! The job is off. Ask %s to try again.
message.guildmark.heist_place.manor: a manor in the noble quarter
message.guildmark.hold_wait: Wait at the Wardfire for nightfall.
message.guildmark.hold_begin: The Hollow are coming! Hold the fire until dawn.
message.guildmark.hold_won: Dawn breaks over the road. The Wardfire holds!
message.guildmark.hold_lost: The Wardfire gutters out. Try again another night.
message.guildmark.hold_far: You left the Wardfire. The night is lost.
message.guildmark.rider_hunt: The Dusk Rider comes with the dusk. Be out in the open as the sun goes down.
message.guildmark.renegade_near: The standing stones hum. Someone is waiting among them.
message.guildmark.no_seat: No faction seat could be found near here.
item.guildmark.heist_prize.hearth_ember: The Ember of the First Hearth
item.guildmark.heist_prize.lore: Stolen. Bring it to whoever sent you.
item.guildmark.starwatch_staff.lore: Made for the last Star of the Starwatch.
item.guildmark.hearthbrand.lore: Forged in the first Wardfire. It burns for those who keep the oath.
item.guildmark.widows_kiss.lore: The knife of the best thief the city ever had.
item.guildmark.greyhart.lore: Harl's sword, the lie hammered out of it. The hart is back on the blade.
item.guildmark.lamplighters_censer.lore: Its flame hasn't gone out since the order began.
item.guildmark.thornwood_bow.lore: Thornwood yew, and a hart's horn at the tip. Kestrel never let anyone else hold it.
item.guildmark.unpicked_star.lore: An apprentice's staff, wound in an old Starwatch robe, its silver star sewn back on.
companion.guildmark.bram.perk: Shield-Brother: while he's beside you, the blows meant for you land 15% softer.
companion.guildmark.ysolde.perk: Last Light: once a day, while she's beside you, a blow that would kill you leaves you standing.
companion.guildmark.kestrel.perk: Hunter's Mark: what her arrows strike glows, and takes 20% more from your blows.
companion.guildmark.lucan.perk: Shared Focus: while he's beside you, your spells cost a quarter less focus.
command.guildmark.faction.seat: Faction seats in the capital at %s, %s: the Starwatch at %s, the Hearthsworn at %s, the Quiet Hand at %s.
command.guildmark.faction.no_capital: Stand in a grand capital first.
message.guildmark.hold_road: Corra's Wardfire is on the road out of the city. Follow your compass to it before dark.
message.guildmark.heist_no_prize: You have to bring %s with you to hand it in. Without it the job isn't done: it's back where you took it from.
message.guildmark.chapter_peaceful: %s lets that job go: in a world this peaceful there's nothing out there to fight. It counts as done.
message.guildmark.chapter_let_go: %s couldn't set that job up here, and lets it go. It counts as done.
message.guildmark.faction_contracts_void: Your contracts from %s are worthless now. You tear them up.
message.guildmark.companion_joined: %s travels with you now. Talk to them to have them wait, or to part ways.
message.guildmark.companion_left: %s has had enough and left you. Give it a day, then rest at a Wardfire: they may come to hear you out.
message.guildmark.companion_help_up: %s is down: crouch and use them to help them up.
message.guildmark.companion_no_dragon: %s lets that hunt go: there's no dragon roost anywhere in this world. It counts as done.
message.guildmark.last_light: %s's Last Light holds you on your feet.
message.guildmark.kindle_trial: Light Wardfires that have gone cold, any you haven't lit before. The map shows those you know of.
command.guildmark.faction.unknown: No faction called %s. Try starwatch, hearthsworn or quiet_hand.
command.guildmark.companion.meet: %s is on their way to you.
command.guildmark.companion.unknown: No companion called %s. Try bram, ysolde, kestrel or lucan.
cutscene.guildmark.renegade.intro.1: Idris sent you? Of course he did.
cutscene.guildmark.renegade.intro.2: He never could bear to look at the dark himself.
cutscene.guildmark.renegade.phase2: Look up! Watch them go out, one by one!
cutscene.guildmark.renegade.death: Tell him... the chart was true...
gui.guildmark.status.factions.none.tip: You haven't joined a faction. Every grand capital has the Starwatch in its library and the Hearthsworn in its barracks yard, and, for those who know where to look, the Quiet Hand up in the plaza tavern's attic.
subtitles.guildmark.faction.spar.yield: Sword set down in the dirt
subtitles.guildmark.companion.downed: Companion goes down on one knee
subtitles.guildmark.companion.revive: Companion is helped to their feet
item.guildmark.cog.tip: Use it on open water to set her afloat. Crouch and strike her to pack her away again, hold and all.
message.guildmark.ship.on_water: Look at open water to set her afloat
message.guildmark.ship.no_room: There isn't open water enough here for her
message.guildmark.ship.not_yours: She isn't yours to pack away
message.guildmark.ship.pack_hint: Crouch and strike her to pack her away
message.guildmark.ship.helm: At the helm · %s and %s work the sail · %s and %s steer · %s the anchor · %s the bell
message.guildmark.ship.deck: Aboard · use the deck to move about · %s opens the hold · %s goes ashore
subtitles.guildmark.sea.maelgrasp.burst: A tentacle bursts from the sea
item.guildmark.maelgrasp_beak.tip: Use it on a cog to lash it to her stem. Gnashfins keep clear of a ship that wears one.
item.guildmark.cog.figurehead: A Maelgrasp's beak at her stem: Gnashfins keep clear of her
message.guildmark.ship.figurehead: The Maelgrasp's beak is lashed to her stem. Gnashfins will keep clear of her
message.guildmark.ship.held_fast: She's held fast. She can't be packed away now
message.guildmark.sea.omen: The wind dies, and the sea goes still and wrong
message.guildmark.sea.rising: Something vast is rising beneath her!
message.guildmark.sea.seized: Seized! Crouch, again and again, to struggle free
message.guildmark.sea.maelgrasp_slain: The Maelgrasp is slain! It sinks into the dark, and its spoils are stowed in the hold of the %s.
message.guildmark.sea.maelgrasp_slain_ho: The Maelgrasp is slain! It sinks into the dark, and its spoils are stowed in her hold.
message.guildmark.sea.maelgrasp_slain_lo: The Maelgrasp is slain! It sinks into the dark, and what it left is in your pack or adrift where it fell.
news.guildmark.maelgrasp_slain: %s slew the Maelgrasp on the open sea, off %s, %s.
commands.guildmark.sea.peaceful: Nothing hunts the sea in Peaceful. Raise the difficulty first
commands.guildmark.sea.no_water: There's no deep, open water out there for it. Try farther from shore
commands.guildmark.sea.gnashfins: A pack of %s Gnashfins is closing in on you
commands.guildmark.sea.not_aboard: Board a cog first: the Maelgrasp only comes for a ship
commands.guildmark.sea.maelgrasp: The sea goes still around her. The Maelgrasp is coming
commands.guildmark.sea.calm: The sea is calm again (%s sent away)
commands.guildmark.island.no_kind: There's no kind of island called %s
commands.guildmark.island.overworld: Islands only rise from the Overworld's seas
commands.guildmark.island.no_sea: Stand out on the open sea first: there's no water at sea level here
commands.guildmark.island.failed: The island couldn't be raised here
commands.guildmark.island.nearest: The nearest island lies at %s, %s, %s blocks away
commands.guildmark.island.not_here: You're not in any island's waters
commands.guildmark.island.info: An island: %s. Its middle is at %s, %s, its land reaches %s blocks out, and it grew from seed %s
quest.guildmark.chart.title: Chart %s Unknown Isles
quest.guildmark.chart.desc: Sail out and sight %s isles you've never laid eyes on. Each goes on your map the moment you see it.
quest.guildmark.salvage.wreck.title: Salvage a Wreck
quest.guildmark.salvage.wreck.desc: A ship went down on a reef out at sea. Find her and get into the captain's chest in her cabin.
quest.guildmark.salvage.cove.title: Rob the Smugglers' Den
quest.guildmark.salvage.cove.desc: Smugglers keep a den in a sea cave on an isle offshore. Get past them and open their strongbox.
quest.guildmark.salvage.shrine.title: Plunder a Drowned Shrine
quest.guildmark.salvage.shrine.desc: A temple to the thing in the deep stands half under the sea. Dive down to its altar and open the chest there.
message.guildmark.no_isle: No isle of that sort lies within a day's sail of here.
message.guildmark.salvaged: Salvaged from %s! Take the contract back to its board.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.chart.0: The shoals have moved out past the edge of the charts. Find me where the isles are and I'll find the fish.
quest.guildmark.story.fisherman.chart.1: My father swore there were isles past the fog bank. Go and prove him right.
quest.guildmark.story.cartographer.chart: Half my sea chart is still blank parchment. Fill it in for me.
Sight the isles and I'll do the inking. Mind you note where the reefs are.
The guild pays well for every isle put on a chart. Go and earn it.
A cog went down on the reef in the last storm. Her captain's chest is still aboard, if the crabs haven't had it.
My brother crewed her. Bring back what the captain kept, so there's something to bury.
quest.guildmark.story.cartographer.salva: Every wreck carries charts. Her captain will have kept his in his chest, and I want them.
Smugglers are undercutting every honest catch. Their strongbox is in a cave out on the isles. Empty it.
They cut my nets and took my catch. Take it back from them, with interest.
quest.guildmark.story.cartographer.salva: There's a temple out at sea that no chart has a name for. They say its altar holds a fortune.
Something old is worshipped in that drowned shrine. Bring me what lies on its altar, and don't linger.
quest.guildmark.story.cleric.salvage.shr: Fishermen pray to the thing in the deep at a shrine out on the isles. Bring me its offerings, before it's fed any more.
That altar under the sea is an insult to every honest god. Strip it bare.
quest.guildmark.slay.title: Slay the %s
quest.guildmark.slay.hill_troll.desc: A hill troll keeps a camp out in the wild, sleeping by its fire by day. Find its camp and put an end to it.
quest.guildmark.slay.dragon.desc: A dragon has taken a high peak for its roost. Climb to its nest and bring it down.
message.guildmark.no_quarry: Nothing of that kind lives within reach of here any more.
message.guildmark.quarry_slain: %s: done! Take the contract back to its board.
news.guildmark.outlaw.caravan: %s, %s, robbed a caravan on the road through %s.
news.guildmark.outlaw.farm: %s, %s, raided a farm in %s and drove off the flock.
news.guildmark.outlaw.barn: %s, %s, burned a barn in %s to the ground.
news.guildmark.outlaw.traveller: %s, %s, held up travellers on the road through %s.
news.guildmark.outlaw.tithe: %s, %s, stole the tithe on its way through %s.
news.guildmark.outlaw.patrol: %s, %s, ambushed a patrol of guards in %s.
news.guildmark.outlaw.camp: %s, %s, has made camp in %s with a band of cutthroats.
news.guildmark.outlaw_slain: %s brought down %s, %s, in %s. The band is broken.
quest.guildmark.bounty.title: Wanted: %s
quest.guildmark.bounty.desc: Bring down the captain of an outlaw band in their own camp. The band will fight for them.
quest.guildmark.wanted_for.traveller: Wanted for holding up travellers in %s.
quest.guildmark.wanted_for.tithe: Wanted for stealing the tithe in %s.
quest.guildmark.wanted_for.patrol: Wanted for ambushing the guard in %s.
quest.guildmark.wanted_for.nothing: Wanted for crimes against the folk of %s.
quest.guildmark.story.bounty.0: There's a price on their head, and more on the poster than there's room for.
quest.guildmark.story.bounty.1: The roads aren't safe while that lot are camped out there.
message.guildmark.no_outlaw: That band's been broken, or has moved on: there's no one left to collect on.
message.guildmark.bounty_held: You already hold the bounty on %s.
message.guildmark.bounty_done: %s is dead: the bounty's yours. Take the contract back to its board.
message.guildmark.bounty_claimed: The bounty on %s has already been claimed, so this contract pays nothing.
message.guildmark.outlaw_slain: %s is dead. The band is broken.
message.guildmark.outlaw_rout: With %s dead, the band breaks and runs!
commands.guildmark.outlaws.overworld: Outlaw bands only make camp in the overworld
commands.guildmark.outlaws.peaceful: Outlaws don't make camp on Peaceful
commands.guildmark.outlaws.no_room: No open, level ground without trees 24 to 36 blocks from here for a camp. Try a plain or a meadow
commands.guildmark.outlaws.here: %s and their band have made camp at %s, %s, %s (%s blocks off)
commands.guildmark.outlaws.none: No outlaw band at large has made camp in this world yet. They're found as you explore, well away from villages
commands.guildmark.outlaws.nearest: %s: camped at %s, %s, %s (%s blocks off), %s of them in all, %s Guild Marks on the captain's head
commands.guildmark.outlaws.crime: %s has %s. The bounty's now %s Guild Marks
news.guildmark.outlaw.raid: %s, %s, raided a village in %s by torchlight.
news.guildmark.outlaw.raid_beaten: Raiders of %s's band were beaten off at %s.
news.guildmark.outlaw.rescued: %s was brought home to %s from an outlaw camp.
quest.guildmark.rescue.title: Rescue %s
quest.guildmark.rescue.desc: Free a villager held in an outlaw camp and see them home. Use them to cut them loose; they'll keep close behind you.
quest.guildmark.held_by: Taken by %s's band. Please, bring them home.
quest.guildmark.story.rescue.0: They came in the night and took one of ours. We can't fight them. Can you?
quest.guildmark.story.rescue.1: Every night we hear them laughing out past the fields. Bring our neighbour back.
message.guildmark.captive_freed: You cut %s loose. Get them home to %s.
message.guildmark.rescue_done: %s is home safe. Hand in the contract for your reward.
message.guildmark.captive_lost: %s didn't make it. There's no one left to bring home.
message.guildmark.no_captive: Whoever this was for isn't held any more: freed, or lost.
message.guildmark.rescue_held: You've already sworn to bring %s home.
message.guildmark.raid_beaten: The raiders are beaten off. %s won't forget who stood with them.
message.guildmark.raid_taken: %s's band got away with %s. They'll be held in the camp.
commands.guildmark.outlaws.no_village: No village bell near enough. Stand in a village
commands.guildmark.outlaws.no_raid: That band is already raiding, or there's no open ground to come in from
commands.guildmark.outlaws.captive: %s's band now holds %s, in their camp at %s, %s, %s
say.guildmark.captive_freed_1: Get me home, please. I'll keep close.
say.guildmark.captive_home_0: Home! I thought I'd never see it again.
say.guildmark.captive_home_1: Bless you, friend. The whole village will hear of this.
say.guildmark.crier_open_1: Hear ye, hear ye! News from the market!
say.guildmark.crier_open_2: Gather round, good people, and hear the news!
say.guildmark.crier_blight_wheat: Blight in the fields! The wheat is failing!
say.guildmark.crier_blight_carrot: Blight in the fields! The carrots are failing!
say.guildmark.crier_blight_potato: Blight in the fields! The potatoes are failing!
say.guildmark.crier_blight_beetroot: Blight in the fields! The beetroot is failing!
say.guildmark.crier_bumper_wheat: A bumper crop of wheat is coming in!
say.guildmark.crier_bumper_carrot: A bumper crop of carrots is coming in!
say.guildmark.crier_bumper_potato: A bumper crop of potatoes is coming in!
say.guildmark.crier_bumper_beetroot: A bumper crop of beetroot is coming in!
say.guildmark.crier_murrain: Murrain among the herds! Meat and hides will be dear!
say.guildmark.crier_fowl_pest: A pest has got among the hens!
say.guildmark.crier_mill_broken: The windmill's sails are broken! Flour will be short!
say.guildmark.crier_oven_cracked: The bakery's oven has cracked! Bread will be short!
say.guildmark.crier_good_catch: The boats are coming in full! Fish is cheap at the quay!
say.guildmark.crier_poor_catch: The nets come up empty! Fish will be dear!
say.guildmark.crier_fever: A fever is going round the town! Keep warm, and rest!
say.guildmark.crier_over_blight: The blight has passed from the fields!
say.guildmark.crier_over_poor_catch: The fish are back in the nets!
say.guildmark.crier_dear_string: String and twine are dear today!
say.guildmark.crier_cheap_string: String and twine are cheap today!
say.guildmark.crier_why_bought_up: Folk have been buying it up!
say.guildmark.crier_why_sold_in: The stalls are piled high with it!
say.guildmark.crier_why_no_flour: The ovens stood cold for want of flour!
say.guildmark.crier_why_no_grain: The mill stood idle for want of grain!
say.guildmark.crier_why_short_handed: Too few hands to make it!
say.guildmark.crier_why_rest_day: The ovens rest on the seventh day!
say.guildmark.crier_why_carts_behind: The carts are behind with the harvest!
say.guildmark.crier_why_worn_tools: The town's tools are worn out!
say.guildmark.crier_why_from_afar: It must come from afar, by caravan!
say.guildmark.crier_why_cold: Every hearth is burning coal against the cold!
say.guildmark.crier_why_warm: Few fires are lit in the warm days!
say.guildmark.crier_why_fields_lean: Little grows in the fields this time of year!
say.guildmark.crier_why_fields_full: The fields are at their best!
say.guildmark.crier_why_orchard_lean: The orchards won't bear till autumn!
say.guildmark.crier_why_orchard_full: The orchards are heavy with fruit!
say.guildmark.crier_why_herds_lean: Few beasts go to the butcher in the cold!
say.guildmark.crier_why_herds_full: The fattened beasts are going to the butcher!
say.guildmark.crier_why_fleece_lean: The sheep won't be shorn till spring!
say.guildmark.crier_why_coops_lean: The coops give little in the short days!
say.guildmark.crier_why_coops_full: The coops are doing well in the long days!
say.guildmark.crier_hungry: The town went hungry yesterday! Food is short!
say.guildmark.crier_quiet: The market is well stocked, and prices are fair!
say.guildmark.crier_board: The prices are up on the board!
say.guildmark.crier_news_slain: A great beast has been slain!
say.guildmark.crier_news_sea: A terror of the deep has been slain!
say.guildmark.crier_news_lair: A monster's lair has been cleared!
say.guildmark.crier_news_rank: The guild has a new champion!
say.guildmark.crier_news_works: A village has finished its new works!
say.guildmark.crier_news_road: A new road is open to travellers!
say.guildmark.crier_news_siege_won: A village has held off a siege!
say.guildmark.crier_news_siege_lost: A village has been overrun by a horde!
say.guildmark.crier_news_outlaws: Outlaws are abroad! Keep to the roads by day!
say.guildmark.crier_news_outlaw_slain: An outlaw captain has been brought down!
say.guildmark.crier_news_rescued: A captive has been brought home!
say.guildmark.crier_news_guild: A new guild has been founded!
say.guildmark.crier_news_banners: Banners are changing over the villages!
say.guildmark.crier_news_king: The Hollow King is no more!
say.guildmark.crier_news_deeds: Great deeds are afoot in the land!
say.guildmark.crier_news_more: More word from the guild halls!
say.guildmark.crier_festival_soon: A festival is coming! Make ready!
say.guildmark.crier_festival_today: The festival is today! Come one, come all!
say.guildmark.crier_season_spring: Spring has come! Time to sow!
say.guildmark.crier_season_autumn: Autumn is upon us! Bring in the harvest!
say.guildmark.crier_season_winter: Winter has come! Lay in your stores!
say.guildmark.crier_close_0: That is the news! Go about your business!
say.guildmark.crier_close_2: So ends the news! Fair trading to you all!
say.guildmark.driver_quiet: Road's quiet. I don't like it.
say.guildmark.driver_greet: Good day! Mind the wheels, now.
say.guildmark.driver_took: They came out of nowhere and took the lot.
say.guildmark.driver_ran: I ran. I'm not proud of it.
say.guildmark.driver_mark: Their camp's out that way. Here, I'll show you.
say.guildmark.driver_next: The next one won't go without more spears.
say.guildmark.driver_escort_meet: You're our escort? Then let's be off.
say.guildmark.driver_escort_done: Never been so glad to see a wall.
say.guildmark.driver_bye: Mind how you go out there.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_1: The wagons aren't safe on the road these days.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_2: Everything off the wagons is dear now.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_3: My brother drives a wagon. I worry for him.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_4: Outlaws on the road, and nobody does a thing.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_5: Somebody ought to deal with those outlaws.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_6: They say the last wagon never came in.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_7: Bread's gone up again. It's that road.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_8: I won't set foot outside the walls till it's sorted.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_clear_1: Wagons are coming in again. About time.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_clear_2: They say the outlaws were broken. Good riddance.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_clear_3: Prices are coming down, thank goodness.
say.guildmark.gossip_road_clear_4: The road's safe again, they say.
say.guildmark.guard_beaten_off: That's it, run! And stay gone!
say.guildmark.guard_cant_hold: There's too many! Can't hold them!
say.guildmark.guard_glad: Glad of you. Watch the treeline.
say.guildmark.crier_waylaid: A wagon was waylaid on the road! Goods will be short!
say.guildmark.crier_over_waylaid: The wagons are getting through again!
say.guildmark.crier_road_troubled: Trouble on the road! Escorts wanted for the wagons!
say.guildmark.crier_road_perilous: The road is perilous! The wagons go together, at noon!
say.guildmark.crier_road_closed: The road is closed! No wagon goes without an escort!
say.guildmark.crier_road_clear: The outlaws are broken! The road is clear again!
say.guildmark.crier_relief: A relief wagon is on its way to us!
say.guildmark.crier_salvage_returned: Goods from the wreck have been brought back! Our thanks!
supplier.guildmark.up: %2$s knows you better as a supplier: you're a %1$s now. Its stalls pay you %3$s%% of their price for your goods. Orders you may hold at once: %4$s.%5$s
supplier.guildmark.up.known: Its businesses may ask you to fill an order every week now.
supplier.guildmark.up.purveyor: Its orders come half as big again for you.
supplier.guildmark.down: %2$s thinks less of you as a supplier: you're a %1$s there now.
supplier.guildmark.taken: %1$s at %3$s is counting on you for %2$s: up to %4$s in all, paid as you bring them in. Bring them %5$s.
supplier.guildmark.standing.offered: %1$s at %3$s would like %2$s from you every week for %4$s weeks, for a tenth more. Accept or decline at its counter before the rest day.
supplier.guildmark.standing.accepted: %1$s at %3$s will look for %2$s from you every week for %4$s weeks: up to %5$s a week. Each week's goods are due before its rest day.
supplier.guildmark.standing.week: Week %1$s of %2$s begins: %4$s at %5$s wants %3$s again.
supplier.guildmark.standing.done: Your standing order of %1$s for %2$s at %3$s is done: every week of it met.
supplier.guildmark.delivered: %3$s takes %1$s %2$s and pays you %4$s: %5$s more to bring.
supplier.guildmark.delivered.week: %3$s takes %1$s %2$s and pays you %4$s: that's this week's order met.
supplier.guildmark.delivered.all: %3$s takes %1$s %2$s and pays you %4$s: that's the whole order filled.
supplier.guildmark.kept_back: You keep back %1$s %2$s bought at this market lately: it won't take its own goods as an order.
supplier.guildmark.given_up: You gave up the order of %1$s for %2$s at %3$s with %4$s still to bring. Your standing there suffers for it.
supplier.guildmark.lapsed: Your order of %1$s for %2$s at %3$s has lapsed with %4$s still to bring. Your standing there suffers for it.
supplier.guildmark.due.tonight: by tonight, before the rest day

quest.guildmark.story.village.slay.hill_: "There's a troll in the hills. It sleeps by its fire all day and comes down for the sheep at night."
"The woodcutters found its camp: bones round a fire, and snoring like a landslide."
quest.guildmark.story.village.slay.drago: "We see it circling the peak at dusk. Every week the herd is smaller."
"They say no blade made by men can pierce it. Go and prove them wrong."
quest.guildmark.story.weaponsmith.slay.h: I want to know if my steel bites troll hide. Go and find out for me.
That troll bent the last sword I sold into a hook. Show it what a good one does.
quest.guildmark.story.butcher.slay.hill_: Something is taking whole cattle from the far pasture, and leaving the bones in a heap by a fire.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.slay.hill: Three ewes gone in a week, and tracks the size of a cart wheel. Find what made them.
quest.guildmark.story.shepherd.slay.drag: It came down out of the clouds and took the ram whole. I'll not graze the high meadow again until it's dead.
quest.guildmark.story.librarian.slay.dra: Our oldest books name every dragon that ever roosted here. This one's chapter needs an ending.
Dragons sleep on what they've hoarded. Some of that hoard was this library's, once.

gui.guildmark.works.ship.struck: Struck by a band! What it carried goes again on the next wagon.
gui.guildmark.works.part.wages.tip: The master builder's and the hired hands' pay.
gui.guildmark.works.part.materials.tip: Timber, stone and the rest, sent for by wagon.
gui.guildmark.works.part.filling.tip: The grain to fill it, bought at the market.
gui.guildmark.works.part.pitch.tip: Your stall's place in the square.
gui.guildmark.works.pledges.none: No one has pledged yet. Be the first!
gui.guildmark.works.pledges.none_stall: Only you can pay for a stall of your own.
gui.guildmark.works.pledges.not_yet: Nothing can be pledged toward it until the town wants it.
gui.guildmark.works.withdraw.tip: Take back what you've pledged, while it isn't paid for yet.
gui.guildmark.works.fortune.off: The town's fortunes aren't being reckoned.
gui.guildmark.works.fortune.no_reasons: Nothing much weighs on the town today.
gui.guildmark.works.regard.title: What %s thinks of you
gui.guildmark.works.regard.off: The townsfolk keep no memory of who's who.
gui.guildmark.works.regard.rest: Met or heard of you: %s · never heard of you: %s
gui.guildmark.works.regard.warms_none: Nothing yet: trade with them, give, help.
gui.guildmark.works.regard.cool.slight.s: salvage you kept off their wagon
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dusk_0: There we are. That'll see you home.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dusk_1: Evening. The lamps are going up.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dusk_2: Not a dark street in the city tonight.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dawn_0: Morning. The sun can take it from here.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dawn_1: There. That's the night seen off.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_dawn_2: Rest now. I'll be back at dusk.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_hello_0: Can't stop long. I've a round to finish.
say.guildmark.lamplighter_hello_2: Someone has to see to the lamps.
news.guildmark.market.event.oven_cracked: One of the bakery's ovens has cracked.
news.guildmark.market.event.good_catch: The boats are coming in full.
news.guildmark.market.event.poor_catch: The fish have gone: the boats come in near empty.
news.guildmark.market.event.fever: A fever is going round the town.
news.guildmark.market.over.blight: The blight has passed: the %s crop is coming up well again.
news.guildmark.market.over.murrain: The murrain is over: the herds are healthy again.
news.guildmark.market.over.fowl_pest: The pest has left the coops: the hens are laying again.
news.guildmark.market.over.mill_broken: The windmill's sails are mended: it turns again.
news.guildmark.market.over.oven_cracked: The bakery's oven is mended: full batches again.
news.guildmark.market.over.poor_catch: The fish are back: the boats come in with full nets.
talk.guildmark.choice.name: I'm %s.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.morning_1: Morning. Up and about, I see.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.morning_2: Good morning. What brings you by?
say.guildmark.talk.greet.long_0: It's been a while. Thought we'd lost you.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.long_0.named: It's been a while, %s. Thought we'd lost you.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.long_1: Look who it is! Where've you been?
say.guildmark.talk.greet.long_1.named: Look who it is! Where've you been, %s?
say.guildmark.talk.greet.friend_1: I was hoping you'd come by.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.friend_1.named: I was hoping you'd come by, %s.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.heard_0: So you're the one they're all talking about.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.heard_1: I've heard about you, you know.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.heard_2: Word of you has got round.
say.guildmark.talk.greet.hero_1: Is it really you? Well, I never!
say.guildmark.talk.bye.friend_1: Come by again soon, won't you?
say.guildmark.talk.bye.friend_1.named: Come by again soon, %s, won't you?
say.guildmark.talk.bye.off_0: I must be off, I'm afraid.
say.guildmark.talk.bye.off_1: Things to see to. Another time!
say.guildmark.talk.bye.off_2: Look at the hour! I'd best be going.
say.guildmark.talk.bye.walked_1: Not so much as a goodbye.
say.guildmark.talk.bye.idle_1: I'll leave you to your thinking.
say.guildmark.talk.name.pleased_2: A pleasure. I'll remember the name.
say.guildmark.talk.name.pleased_2.named: %1$s. A pleasure, %2$s. I'll remember the name.
say.guildmark.talk.ask.yes_0: What can I do for you?
say.guildmark.talk.ask.queue_0: One at a time, one at a time!
say.guildmark.talk.ask.all_2: I've told you all I have.
say.guildmark.talk.ask.other_1: That's not how I heard it.
say.guildmark.talk.ask.cold_0: I've nothing to say to you.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.rise_0: Only just up. Still rubbing the sleep from my eyes.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.rise_1: Waking up, slowly. Don't rush me.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.breakfast_0: Breakfast first. Nothing gets done on an empty stomach.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.lunch_0: Stopping for a bite. A body has to eat.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.lunch_1: Midday, and my stomach knows it.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.market_1: Off to the stalls, before the best of it's gone.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.market_2: A bit of shopping. The larder's looking bare.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.water_0: Fetching water. The house never has enough.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.water_1: To the well and back. My arms will feel it.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.errand_0: Taking something across town. Someone's waiting on it.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.errand_1: Running an errand. Never a moment's peace.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.visit_0: Calling on a neighbour. There'll be something on the fire.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.visit_1: Paying a neighbour a visit. We'll put the world to rights.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.worship_0: Off to the temple, for a prayer or two.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.worship_1: Going to say my prayers. It keeps me right.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.stroll_1: A turn about the town. My legs need it.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.tavern_0: One drink. Two at the most.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.tavern_1: The tavern, for good ale and better company.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.tavern_2: A mug of ale and a bit of a sit-down.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.supper_0: Supper. I'll not be kept from it.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.supper_1: Home for supper. About time, too.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.evening_0: A quiet evening by the fire. That's all I ask.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.bed_0: Off to bed, before I drop where I stand.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.bed_1: It's late. My bed's calling me.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.rest_0: It's the rest day. I'm doing nothing at all, and gladly.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.rest_1: No work today. The seventh day is for resting.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.rest_2: A day off. My hands don't know what to do.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.smith_0: Hammer and anvil, all day long. I don't hear half of what's said.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.smith_1: There's iron in the fire, so I can't stop long.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.smith_2: Hinges, nails, hoes. There's always something wants making.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.smith_idle_0: The forge is idle. Nothing to put on the anvil.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.baker_0: Up since before dawn, and the ovens still hot.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.baker_1: Kneading and baking. The town eats more than you'd think.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.baker_2: Another batch in the oven. The smell is the best part.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.baker_cold_1: Cold ovens, and folk wanting bread. It's no good.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.merchant_0: Minding the stall. Somebody has to.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.merchant_1: Selling what I can, while there's folk to buy it.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.merchant_2: The stall keeps me on my feet from morning till night.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.guard_0: On watch. Keeping the peace, mostly.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.guard_1: Standing my watch. The day goes slow on duty.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.guard_night_0: Night watch. Long and quiet, if we're lucky.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.guard_night_1: Keeping watch while the town sleeps.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.farmer_sow_0: Sowing. What goes in now feeds us all come autumn.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.farmer_sow_1: Sowing, row after row. My back's had enough already.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.farmer_tend_0: Tending the fields. There's always something wants doing.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.farmer_tend_1: Mending and minding. A farm's never finished.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.farmer_reap_0: Harvest. Every pair of hands is wanted.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.farmer_reap_1: Bringing it in before the weather turns.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.fisher_0: Line in the water, and patience. That's fishing.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.fisher_1: A quiet spot, a good line. Can't ask for more.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.fisher_catch_0: Not a bad catch so far.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.fisher_catch_1: The water's been kind. I've got a few.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.fisher_none_0: Not so much as a nibble.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.fisher_none_1: The fish are keeping to themselves today.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.inn_0: Pouring and wiping, wiping and pouring.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.inn_1: Keeping the mugs full and the peace kept.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.inn_2: Behind the bar, where I belong.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.priest_0: Keeping the temple, and the candles lit.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.priest_1: Prayers for the town, morning and evening.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.priest_2: Anyone may come in and sit. The door's open.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.noble_0: Seeing the city. One must, now and then.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.noble_1: Out among the people, where one ought to be.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.noble_2: A little air, a little conversation. Very civilised.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.bard_0: A song or two, for whoever will listen.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.bard_1: Between tunes. My fingers need a rest.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.carter_0: Grain to the mill, flour to the ovens. All day, every day.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.carter_1: Hauling for the town. The cart's never empty for long.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.carter_2: The cart and I know every street by now.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.crier_0: The news, at noon. Come and hear it.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.crier_1: Prices on the board, news in the square. That's my day.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.miller_0: Grinding. The stones never rest while there's grain.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.miller_1: In goes the grain, out comes the flour. Mind the dust.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.mage_0: Study, always study. The stars keep their secrets well.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.mage_1: Reading, writing, and a little conjuring. A mage's day.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.knight_0: Drill, then watch, then drill again. That's the oath.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.knight_1: Keeping the hearth and the road, as sworn.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.citizen_1: A bit of this and a bit of that. It all needs doing.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.citizen_2: Keeping the house in order. It never stays that way.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.craft_0: At the bench. Steady hands, steady work.
say.guildmark.talk.doing.craft_1: Making and mending. There's a knack to it.
say.guildmark.talk.market.dear_1: Have you seen the prices? I don't know how folk manage.
say.guildmark.talk.market.dear_2: My purse gets lighter every time I go to market.
say.guildmark.talk.market.cheap_0: Cheap at the stalls today, for once.
say.guildmark.talk.market.cheap_1: The prices are kind just now. Buy while you can.
say.guildmark.talk.market.short_0: Can't get it for love nor money.
say.guildmark.talk.market.short_1: The stalls have run short. Folk are grumbling.
say.guildmark.talk.market.short_2: There's none to be had. I've looked everywhere.
say.guildmark.talk.market.hungry_0: The pot's been thin at our house.
say.guildmark.talk.market.hungry_1: There's not enough to go round. Folk are going hungry.
say.guildmark.talk.market.hungry_2: I've tightened my belt, and I'm not the only one.
say.guildmark.talk.market.no_bread_0: No bread to be had. Not one loaf.
say.guildmark.talk.market.no_bread_1: The bread's all gone, and there's mouths to feed.
say.guildmark.talk.market.mill_0: The mill's not turning. Flour will be short.
say.guildmark.talk.market.mill_1: No flour from the mill. The bakers are at their wits' end.
say.guildmark.talk.market.no_fish_0: Not a fish to be had.
say.guildmark.talk.market.no_fish_1: No fish at the stalls. Somebody's going without.
say.guildmark.talk.market.glad_0: Good news at the market, for a change.
say.guildmark.talk.market.glad_1: Things are looking up at the stalls.
say.guildmark.talk.market.shopping_0: Just the usual bits and pieces.
say.guildmark.talk.market.shopping_1: Got what I came for, and a bit more besides.
say.guildmark.talk.market.shopping_2: I always spend more than I mean to.
say.guildmark.talk.town.festival_soon_0: There's a festival coming. You can feel it in the streets.
say.guildmark.talk.town.festival_soon_1: Festival soon. The whole town's getting ready.
say.guildmark.talk.town.ribbonwake_0: Ribbonwake soon. I mean to find a ribbon this year.
say.guildmark.talk.town.ribbonwake_1: Ribbonwake's coming. Nothing beats the ribbon pole.
say.guildmark.talk.town.sunhearth_0: Sunhearth soon. Wait till you see the great fire.
say.guildmark.talk.town.sunhearth_1: Sunhearth's coming. I've been practising at the butts.
say.guildmark.talk.town.sheafmoot_0: Sheafmoot soon. I've been baking for it all week.
say.guildmark.talk.town.sheafmoot_1: Sheafmoot's coming. The produce show's always a fight.
say.guildmark.talk.town.lanternrise_0: Lanternrise soon. I've a lantern half made.
say.guildmark.talk.town.lanternrise_1: Lanternrise is coming. Have you got a lantern yet?
say.guildmark.talk.town.festival_today_0: Festival day! The whole town's out.
say.guildmark.talk.town.festival_today_1: It's festival day. Enjoy it while it lasts.
say.guildmark.talk.town.festival_after_0: My head's still aching from the festival.
say.guildmark.talk.town.festival_after_1: What a festival that was. I'm still tired.
say.guildmark.talk.town.death_0: We've lost one of our own. Sad business.
say.guildmark.talk.town.death_1: There's been a death in the town. It's hit us all hard.
say.guildmark.talk.town.newcomer_0: There's new folk in the town. Have you met them?
say.guildmark.talk.town.newcomer_1: New neighbours in the town. We'll see what they're like.
say.guildmark.talk.town.monster_0: There was a monster in the streets. In the streets!
say.guildmark.talk.town.monster_1: Lock your door at night. There's been a monster about.
say.guildmark.talk.town.monster_2: A monster, right here in town. I've not slept since.
say.guildmark.talk.town.crier_0: Did you hear what the crier had to say?
say.guildmark.talk.town.crier_1: The crier's news has the whole square talking.
say.guildmark.talk.town.outlaws_0: There's outlaws on the roads again. Travel by day.
say.guildmark.talk.town.outlaws_1: Nobody's safe on the roads with those outlaws about.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.rain_1: It's coming down, and no mistake.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.storm_0: Thunder like that turns the milk.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.snow_1: Look at it snow. Pretty, if you're not out in it.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.cold_0: There's a bite in the air.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.cold_1: Keep moving, or the cold gets in your bones.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.hot_0: Hot enough to bake bread on the cobbles.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.clearing_0: Dry at last. I thought it'd never stop.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.clearing_1: That's the rain done with, thank goodness.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.fine_0: Fine weather. Make the most of it.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.night_0: A clear night. Look at all those stars.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.night_1: Lovely night, isn't it? Clear as glass.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.spring_0: Spring at last. Everything's coming up green.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.summer_0: Summer. Long days, and short tempers.
say.guildmark.talk.sky.autumn_0: Autumn already. Where does the year go?
say.guildmark.talk.sky.winter_0: Winter. Keep your fire well fed.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.beast_0: They say you killed a great beast. Is it true?
say.guildmark.talk.deed.beast_1: Everyone's talking about that beast you brought down.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.beast_seen_0: I saw you bring that thing down. Never seen the like.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.beast_seen_1: I watched you fight that beast. My heart was in my mouth.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.dragon_0: A dragon! You really killed a dragon?
say.guildmark.talk.deed.dragon_1: A dragon-slayer, here in our town. Who'd have thought it?
say.guildmark.talk.deed.lair_0: You cleared out a monster's lair, they say. Brave work.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.lair_1: One monster's lair gone, thanks to you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.siege_0: They say you held off a siege. That took some nerve.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.band_0: You broke that band of outlaws! The roads are better for it.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.band_1: That band won't trouble anyone again, thanks to you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.escort_0: You brought the wagon in safe. We'd have gone short without it.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.salvage_0: You brought back what the wagon lost. That was honest of you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.order_0: That order you filled came just in time.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.contract_0: You've been busy on the guild's board, I hear.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.contract_1: Another contract done, they say. You don't sit still, do you?
say.guildmark.talk.deed.festival_0: You took the prize at the festival! Well done.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.festival_1: We're still talking about your win at the festival.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.rank_0: Risen in the guild, I hear. Congratulations.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.rank_1: A new rank, they say. Good for you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.kindle_0: They say you've been lighting the old Wardfires again.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.monster_town_0: You dealt with that monster in town. Thank you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.monster_town_1: That creature would have had someone, if not for you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.saved_0: You saved my life. I won't forget it.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.saved_1: If you hadn't come when you did... thank you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.rescued_0: You got me out of there. I owe you more than I can say.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.praise_0: Heard what you did. Good on you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.praise_1: People speak well of you, you know.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.praise_2: The town's glad to have you, and that's the truth.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.doubt_0: Can't believe everything you hear, mind.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.doubt_1: So they say. I wasn't there to see it.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.theft_1: Keep your fingers out of other folk's purses.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.hurt_0: You raised your hand to us. We've not forgotten.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.hurt_1: Keep your fists to yourself, if you know what's good for you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.murder_0: You've a nerve, showing your face here.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.murder_1: I know what you did. Everyone does.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.homestead_0: They say you're building yourself a homestead. Good for you.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.homestead_1: That homestead of yours is coming along, I hear.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.faction_0: I hear you've taken sides. I hope it's the right one.
say.guildmark.talk.deed.faction_1: So you're one of them now, are you?
say.guildmark.talk.deed.faction_2: Word is you've found yourself some new friends.
say.guildmark.talk.deal.regular_0: Always glad to see a regular.
say.guildmark.talk.deal.regular_0.named: Always glad to see a regular, %s.
say.guildmark.talk.deal.regular_1: You're one of my best customers.
say.guildmark.talk.deal.regular_1.named: You're one of my best customers, %s.
say.guildmark.talk.deal.sold_0: What you sold me went in an hour.
say.guildmark.talk.deal.sold_1: Those goods of yours sold in no time.
say.guildmark.talk.news.frame.seen_1: I was there, I tell you...
say.guildmark.talk.news.frame.well_0: They were saying at the well...
say.guildmark.talk.news.frame.secret_0: Don't say I told you, but...
say.guildmark.talk.news.dragon_1: ...a dragon's been slain. A real one!
say.guildmark.talk.news.sea_0: ...the great beast of the sea is dead.
say.guildmark.talk.news.beast_1: ...a monster's been brought down, a big one.
say.guildmark.talk.news.siege_lost_0: ...a village has fallen to a horde.
say.guildmark.talk.news.band_0: ...there's a band of outlaws working the roads.
say.guildmark.talk.news.band_1: ...outlaws are robbing folk on the roads.
say.guildmark.talk.news.band_broken_0: ...the outlaws on the roads have been scattered.
say.guildmark.talk.news.rank_0: ...one of the guild folk has risen in rank.
say.guildmark.talk.news.murder_0: ...someone was murdered. Here, in our town.
say.guildmark.talk.news.murder_1: ...there's been a killing, and not by any beast.
say.guildmark.talk.news.monster_0: ...there was a monster loose in the streets.
say.guildmark.talk.news.far_1: ...big things are happening, a long way off.
say.guildmark.talk.reply.doubt_0: I'll believe it when I see it.
say.guildmark.talk.home.busy_0: No rest at our house. There's always something.
say.guildmark.talk.home.busy_1: A full house keeps you on your feet.
say.guildmark.talk.home.children_0: The little ones keep me on my toes.
say.guildmark.talk.home.children_1: Children! They'll be the death of me.
say.guildmark.talk.home.new_0: We've only just moved in. Still finding our feet.
say.guildmark.talk.home.new_1: We're new here. Still learning which street is which.
say.guildmark.talk.home.grief_0: The house is quiet without them.
say.guildmark.talk.home.grief_1: We lost someone dear. It's hard.
say.guildmark.talk.home.grief_2: I keep setting a place for them at the table.
say.guildmark.talk.home.nobed_0: Still no bed for me. The floor's hard, I can tell you.
say.guildmark.talk.home.neighbours_0: Don't get me started on the neighbours.
say.guildmark.talk.home.neighbours_1: The neighbours keep me up half the night.
say.guildmark.talk.home.neighbours_2: Between you and me, I've had words with next door.
say.guildmark.talk.home.hungry_0: We've been going without at home.
say.guildmark.talk.home.hungry_1: I went to bed hungry, and I'm not the only one.
say.guildmark.talk.home.robbed_0: Someone had my purse. A week's wages, gone.
say.guildmark.talk.home.robbed_1: I was robbed. I still can't believe it.
say.guildmark.talk.home.old_0: My knees tell the weather before the sky does.
say.guildmark.talk.home.old_1: I've seen more winters than I care to count.
say.guildmark.talk.home.old_2: Nobody listens to the old. We were young once, you know.
say.guildmark.talk.child.news_1: I know something you don't know!
say.guildmark.talk.child.deed_0: Did you really do it? Everyone says you did!
say.guildmark.talk.child.deed_1: When I grow up, I'll be just like you!

say.guildmark.talk.works.wanted.oven_0: We could do with a second oven.

say.guildmark.talk.works.eased.tower_0: Good thing we've a watch on the road. It's proved its worth.
say.guildmark.talk.works.eased.tower_1: The watchtower did its job. That's what it's there for.
say.guildmark.talk.works.late_0: The work's held up. They're waiting on the wagon.
say.guildmark.talk.works.late_1: It's all stopped till the wagon comes in.
say.guildmark.talk.works.patron_0: You paid for it, didn't you? Bless you.
say.guildmark.talk.works.patron_0.named: You paid for it, didn't you, %s? Bless you.
say.guildmark.talk.works.patron_1: That was your doing. Thank you.

say.guildmark.talk.works.patron_2: The whole town's grateful to you.
say.guildmark.talk.works.patron_2.named: The whole town's grateful to you, %s.
say.guildmark.talk.works.patron_other_0: We've a friend of the town to thank for it.

say.guildmark.talk.works.patron_there_0: That's the one who paid for it, over there.
say.guildmark.talk.works.patron_there_1: See them? It was them that paid for it.
say.guildmark.talk.works.labourer_0: I had a hand in building that, you know.
say.guildmark.talk.works.labourer_1: I helped build that. I'll be telling my grandchildren.
say.guildmark.talk.works.labourer_2: My own two hands went into that.

say.guildmark.talk.fortune.hard_2: It's hard going in the town just now.
say.guildmark.talk.fortune.lean_0: Lean times. We're getting by, just about.

say.guildmark.talk.fortune.good_0: Times are good. Long may they last.

say.guildmark.talk.fortune.thriving_0: Never seen the town so lively.

say.guildmark.talk.fortune.thriving_2: These are the best days I can remember.
say.guildmark.talk.fortune.better_1: Better than it was, that's for sure.
say.guildmark.talk.fortune.better_2: It's getting better, little by little.

say.guildmark.talk.fortune.gone_0: They've gone. Times were too hard for them.

say.guildmark.talk.fortune.back_0: They're back! Good to see their lamp lit again.
say.guildmark.talk.fortune.back_1: They've come home again. I knew they would.
say.guildmark.talk.comings.arrive_1: A fresh start. Let's hope it's a kind town.
say.guildmark.talk.comings.leave_0: We can't stay. Not with times like these.
say.guildmark.talk.comings.leave_1: It breaks my heart to go, but we've no choice.
say.guildmark.talk.comings.home_0: Home again. I never thought I'd be so glad.

say.guildmark.talk.streets.alms_thanks_2: It's warm, at least. Thank you.

say.guildmark.talk.streets.watch_quiet_2: Quiet out there. Just how I like it.

say.guildmark.talk.streets.first_bread_2: First bake from the new oven! Here, try it!

say.guildmark.talk.child.hungry_0: I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?

say.guildmark.talk.works.yours_0: You gave toward it yourself, I hear.
say.guildmark.talk.works.yours_1: Some of that came from your own purse. Thank you.

The granary's paid for. Now we wait on the wagons.

say.guildmark.talk.works.also.funded.tow: There's the watchtower as well, paid for and waiting.

say.guildmark.talk.works.also.building.g: The granary's going up as well.
The great granary's going up as well.

say.guildmark.talk.works.also.building.t: The watchtower's going up as well.

say.guildmark.talk.works.also.raised.gra: And there's the granary, of course.

handbook.guildmark.page19:
TALES

A town has troubles of its own. A word at a door may ask for your help. Say yes, then watch your tracker: amber, there is time; red, today.

Ask a neighbour Why? Saying no costs nothing.
