Take that along to the inn.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.busy_2: Hold on, I'm in the middle of something.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.alms_fin: What a lovely thing to give. Bless you.
A dish like that for the poor? Bless you.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.inn_no_0: That's baker's work. Take it along to the bakery.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.inn_no_1: I don't buy baking here. The baker will.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.off_0: I only buy through the market, I'm sorry.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.spoilt_0: That batch is spoilt. I couldn't sell it to anyone.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.spoilt_1: Spoilt right through. No, I can't take that.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.gruel_0: That's gruel. The alms table will take it, not I.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.gruel_1: Gruel is for the poor. Take it to the alms table.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.mess_0: That's not a dish I can sell.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.mess_1: I can't do anything with that.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.carry_0: That's not a whole Mark yet. I'll keep the rest for your next.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.carry_1: Less than a Mark, that. I'll count it with the next.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.request_: That's the very dish I asked for. Thank you.
Just what the slate asked for. A little extra for you.
gui.guildmark.cook.menu.request.known: Requests are for cooks the innkeeper knows.
message.guildmark.cook.door.request.lock: The day's request is kept for cooks the innkeeper knows: paid as any dish.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.request_: That's a special order, and I keep those for cooks I know.
I'll pay the usual for that. Special orders go to cooks I know better.
ware.guildmark.carriers_warrant.tip: A sealed bond of good name from the hall: with it you may take consignments, relief and feast tickets, and have a Carriers' Store raised for you.
ware.guildmark.carriers_warrant_again.ti: A Warrant that was lost, copied out of the hall's book and sealed again, free of charge.
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.deliverie: Deliveries made (a consignment counts 2, a relief 3)
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.warrant: The Carrier's Warrant (60 Marks at the hall's counter)
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.store: A Carriers' Store of your own
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.stall: A table or a pitch in another capital
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.ask.house: A Counting House of your own
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.warrant.trust: Be Trusted at a capital first
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.warrant.known: Be Known at three capitals first
Be Known at every open capital first
gui.guildmark.trade.ladder.warrant.none: You hold no Warrant to copy
message.guildmark.trade.rung.hawker: You are a Hawker now: three tickets at a time, and a harness and a donkey from the hall's counter.
message.guildmark.trade.rung.chapman: You are a Chapman now: consignments, relief and feast tickets are yours to take, four tickets at a time.
message.guildmark.trade.rung.factor: You are a Factor now: six tickets at a time, three guards, and the Store's bonded goods and half rent on your tables.
message.guildmark.trade.rung.house: You are Trader of the House now: eight tickets at a time, and carters of your own on the road.
message.guildmark.trade.warrant.read: The hall's book has you down as a %s with %s deliveries to your name, and this Warrant is the hall's word for it.
message.guildmark.trade.warrant.unknown: The hall's book has no Warrant under your name, so this sheet is only paper.
advancements.guildmark.chapman.title: Chapman
advancements.guildmark.chapman.descripti: Win the hall's trust: a Carrier's Warrant, sealed for a carrier of good name.
advancements.guildmark.factor.title: Factor
advancements.guildmark.factor.descriptio: Have a Carriers' Store raised in one town and keep a table or a pitch in another.
advancements.guildmark.trading_house.des: Have a Counting House raised, and send carters out under your own colours.
bonus.guildmark.word_fresh: %s hours fresher news from the other towns
bonus.guildmark.road_wary: %s wariness on the road (the Hunt finds your loads that much less often)
message.guildmark.cook.private: This one is kept for whoever set it down, and their party.
message.guildmark.cook.guest_no: The innkeeper shakes her head: the back pot is for those she knows.
message.guildmark.cook.nothing_to_burn: There's nothing in the fire to light.
message.guildmark.cook.fuel_too_much: That's too much for the fire.
message.guildmark.cook.fuel_full: The fire can't hold any more.
message.guildmark.cook.fuel: The fire is fed: %s of fuel.
message.guildmark.cook.fire_lit: The fire burns: %s of fuel left.
message.guildmark.cook.fire_cold: The fire is out. It has %s of fuel.
message.guildmark.cook.call.stick: The pot is catching: stir it with a ladle.
message.guildmark.cook.call.stick.pan: The pan is catching: scrape it with the turner.
message.guildmark.cook.call.boil_over: It's about to boil over: ease the heat.
message.guildmark.cook.call.skim: Scum is rising: skim it with a ladle.
message.guildmark.cook.call.flare: The fat has caught: ease the heat.
message.guildmark.cook.call.turn: One side is browning: turn it with the turner.
message.guildmark.cook.call.turn.spit: One side is browning: turn the crank.
message.guildmark.cook.call.season: It wants a touch of something: a herb, honey, an egg, milk or a mushroom.
message.guildmark.cook.missed.flare: The fat flared and scorched it.
message.guildmark.cook.missed.season: The moment for seasoning has passed.
message.guildmark.cook.closed: Nothing more goes in once it is on the heat.
message.guildmark.cook.full: There is no room for more.
message.guildmark.cook.water_full: The pot is full of water already.
message.guildmark.cook.light_first: The fire must be lit, with fuel in it, first.
message.guildmark.cook.dry: The pot needs water first: pour in a bucket.
message.guildmark.cook.too_little: There is too little in it to cook.
message.guildmark.cook.burnt: It has burnt. Tip it out: sneak with an empty hand.
message.guildmark.cook.taste_none: You can't taste anything in particular.
message.guildmark.cook.taste_empty: There is nothing to taste yet.
message.guildmark.cook.taste_burnt: Bitter and black: it has burnt.
message.guildmark.cook.tip_empty: There is nothing to tip out.
message.guildmark.cook.tip_sure: That would lose what is cooking. Tip again within four seconds to be sure.
message.guildmark.cook.served.gruel: That is no dish anyone knows: %s.
message.guildmark.cook.use_knife: A pie or a tart is cut with the knife.
message.guildmark.cook.use_turner: That is lifted out with the turner.
message.guildmark.cook.shut_first: Shut the door first: an empty hand on it.
message.guildmark.cook.not_prep: Only vegetables, roots, fruit, meat and fish can be prepared.
message.guildmark.cook.board_busy: The board holds something else: take that off first.
message.guildmark.cook.board_empty: There is nothing on the board.
subtitles.guildmark.cook.place: A cooking station is set down
subtitles.guildmark.cook.fuel: Fuel is thrown on a fire
subtitles.guildmark.cook.ripe: A dish is at its best
gui.guildmark.tale.banner.off: Tale banners are off (Settings, Interface, Tale Banners)
say.guildmark.talk.tale.ask.later_1: Come back if you change your mind.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.ask.lead_0: Someone's already seeing to it. You could help.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.ask.lead_1: A traveller has taken it on. They could use you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.set.call_1: Come out, it's not funny now!
say.guildmark.talk.tale.after.thanks_0: I haven't forgotten what you did.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.after.thanks_1: You're always welcome at our door.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.after.glad_0: Nice to hear something go right.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.after.glad_1: Glad that's mended. A good thing.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.after.sorry_0: A sad business. I wish it had gone better.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.after.sorry_1: Nobody's fault, but it's a pity.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.after.old_0: I remember that. It was a hard season.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.after.old_1: That's a story the town still tells.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.ask_0: I'm into a man for more than I can pay.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.ask_1: I borrowed against this stall, and now it's due.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.passing_0: Hard days, and a man wanting his money.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.passing_1: Lean times. I'm behind, and it shows.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.rumour_0: They say a stall keeper owes a lender, and it's due.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.rumour_1: Someone on the row is behind with the lender.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.stand_0: Still owing, but less than before.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.paid_0: It's done. It's truly done. Thank you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.paid_1: I can breathe again. I'll not forget you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.lease_0: I'll keep the lease. She stays on as my keeper.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.lease_1: The stall is mine now. She'll keep it for me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.sealed_0: That's that, then. Take it, all of it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.sealed_1: I'll not beg. Shut it up.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.progress_1: That helps more than you know.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.lender_grac: On your word. A few days only.
A few days. You answer for it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.lender_sums: These sums are wrong. I stand corrected.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.lender_law_: The Order's law. I'll take less.
I'd not cross the Order. Less, then.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.lender_word: Say no more. I'll take less.
Heard. We'll say no more of it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.note.quits_0: Paid in full. We are quits.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.ask_0: There's an empty chair at my table.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.passing_0: It's very quiet in the house.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.rumour_0: The town hasn't marked it yet, you know.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.rumour_1: They say nobody's laid a stone.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.priest_0: A stone, three candles, and three who remember.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.priest_1: What's proper is a stone and a few kind words.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.word_a_0: Always a kind word for everyone.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.word_a_1: You never saw them without a smile.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.word_b_0: Never a day without work done well.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.word_b_1: They gave more than they ever took.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.word_c_0: Could make us laugh at the worst of times.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.word_c_1: They'll be missed at every table.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.laying_0: We lay one of our own to rest.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.laying_1: Light and peace to one who is gone.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.thanks_0: The chair isn't so empty now.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.thanks_1: Thank you for remembering them with me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.leave_0: There's nothing here for us now.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.leave_1: We'll go where it doesn't hurt.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.stand_0: Three words, three candles, and a place.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.stand_1: I only want it done well.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.chair.candles_0: A candle for each who will come.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.ask_0: They took the wagon, and my own went with it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.ask_1: The wagon came back without the second hand.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.passing_0: I can't sleep. I keep watching the gate.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.passing_1: Any word of the road? Any word at all?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.rumour_0: They say the band took someone with the wagon.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.rumour_1: Someone from the town went with that wagon.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.driver_han: They took one alive. A rider came about a price.
They kept the second hand. They want paying.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.captain_ye: I'll ride at dawn, on your word.
Show me where, and I'll take the watch.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.thanks_0: You brought them back. I'll not forget it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.thanks_1: Whatever you ask of me, ask.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.cairn_0: At least there's a place to come to.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.cairn_1: They'll be remembered here, whatever else.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.stand_1: The camp's known. The rest is up to us.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.captain_no: Not without a name I trust.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.parley_0: Bring the coin and take your own.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.parley_1: The price is set. Pay, and walk.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.released_0: Take them. We're done with each other.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.released_1: Walk them out. Don't look back.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.wagon.found_0: You came. I hoped someone would.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.ask_0: My little one's not in the house or the yard.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.ask_1: My child's gone. Out of the gate, they say.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.passing_0: Have you seen a small one with a bundle?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.passing_1: They've run off, and I'm sick with worry.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.rumour_0: The new family's little one has gone missing.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.rumour_1: They say a child's gone off down the road.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.guard_0: A small one went out with a bundle, down the road.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.guard_1: I saw one go out. I thought a parent was behind.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.thanks_0: You found my little one. I'll never forget it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.thanks_1: We came here for a better life. Now I believe it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.leave_0: This town was a mistake. We're going back.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.leave_1: We'll try the old road. It was kinder.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.child.stand_1: Out on the road, in the dark.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.shout_a_0: You know very well what you did!
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.shout_a_1: I'll not be told by you!
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.shout_b_0: I did nothing of the sort!
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.shout_b_1: Look to your own door first!
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.willing_0: I'd sit with them if they came.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.willing_1: Perhaps. If it's not me who asks.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.arranged_0: At the well at dusk. I'll come.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.arranged_1: Dusk, then. I'll bring my own cup.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.sorry_1: Let's not speak of it again.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.same_0: And I. Sit, the bread's getting cold.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.ask_0: My neighbour and I are not speaking. It's foolish.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.ask_1: I've said things I can't unsay.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.rumour_0: Two neighbours on the lane have stopped speaking.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.rumour_1: There's a quarrel on the lane. A small thing.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.side_a_0: It was a small thing at first. Then it wasn't.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.side_a_1: They know what they did. I'll not say it twice.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.side_b_0: I'm not the one who started this.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.fence.side_b_1: Ask them what they said first.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.ask_0: I haven't played in days. I haven't the heart.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.ask_1: The square's gone quiet, and that's on me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.rumour_0: The bard's pawned her lute, you know.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.rumour_1: It's been quiet in the square since the bard stopped.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.keeper_0: The loan stands until it's repaid.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.keeper_1: I'm not a charity. I'm an inn.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.parts_0: Half now, half after, and she can play.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.parts_1: Part now, the rest soon. I'll trust you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.vouch_0: Your word's good here. One night, no more.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.vouch_1: One night, then it comes back to me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.thanks_0: My lute. My own lute. I could weep.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.thanks_1: I'll play for you tonight, and gladly.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.intro_0: This one's for the whole of the square.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.glum_0: I'll find another way, in time.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.glum_1: The square will manage without me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.stand_0: The lute's the only thing I need.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.stand_1: I'd play again if I could.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lute.returned_0: Back to me, then. Sleep well.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.ask_0: The town can't agree, and it will cost us all.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.ask_1: The bell is rung. Say what you will.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.for_0: We need it. Every day we wait costs us.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.for_1: Put it up, and be glad of it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.against_0: We can't spend what we haven't got.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.against_1: Who pays for it? Not me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.good_0: The moot has heard. The town will give.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.good_1: It is decided. The town will help build it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.half_0: Half, then. And may it be enough.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.half_1: The town gives a part. The rest is for willing hands.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.deferred_0: No one carries the room. We'll meet again.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.broke_0: Enough! The moot is ended, and badly.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.broke_1: This helps no one. Go home.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.stand_0: The moot meets soon. Be ready.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.stand_1: Think what is true, and say it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.moot.thanks_0: Well said. The town is grateful.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.ask_0: My neighbours left in lean days. Their cart's stuck out there.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.ask_1: That empty house had a good family. Someone saw their cart.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.passing_0: I still look for their lamp each evening.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.passing_1: Nobody has lit that window since they went.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.rumour_0: They say a family's camped by the road, stuck.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.rumour_1: A cart with a broken wheel, out past the farms.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.found_0: Who's there? Are you from the town?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.found_1: Keep back! We've nothing left to take.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.wheel_0: The wheel's gone, and all we own is on it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.wheel_1: We can't leave it, and we can't move it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.night_0: The road's bad after dark. We'll go at first light.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.night_1: Not tonight. We'll walk when the road is safe.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.guard_yes_0: Two of us can ride at first light, for a fee.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.guard_yes_1: We'll walk them in. It won't be free.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.safe_0: The road's quiet. We'll set off at first light.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.safe_1: Safe at last. We can go now.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.go_ahead_0: Go on ahead, and tell them we're coming.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.go_ahead_1: We'll follow. Tell the street we're coming home.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.thanks_0: You brought us home. We'll never forget it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.thanks_1: We were lost, and you found us.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.moved_0: We can't wait. We'll try the next town.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.moved_1: There's nothing here for us. We're going on.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.stand_0: Still no sign of them coming back.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.stand_1: Someone ought to go and see them.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.thanks_wood: Good timber. Give me a moment.
That will do it. Thank you!
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.mended_0: It rolls again! Look at that!
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.mended_1: Sound as new. We're in your debt.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.keep_0: Stay near. We'll be glad of it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.guard_set_0: Done. We ride at first light.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.guard_set_1: Understood. Two of us will go.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.loaf_0: I baked this, in case you came.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.cart.loaf_1: Welcome home. You must be starving.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.ask_0: Every Lanternrise I let one go. My legs won't carry me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.ask_1: A lantern for the one I miss. The square's too far.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.passing_: I'll watch the lanterns from my window, I suppose.
These legs don't go to the square anymore.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.shall_0: Shall we go, then? Slowly, mind.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.shall_1: It's a long way. Will you walk with me?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.late_0: Too late for the square now. I'll sit with it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.late_1: The lanterns will go without me. It's all right.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.release_: Go up now. Go up and be seen.
Rise, little light. Tell them I remember.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.thanks_0: I'd not have managed it. Thank you, dear.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.thanks_1: You've a kind heart. They'd have liked you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.window_0: I'll let it go from the door. It'll find its way.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.window_1: Thank you for the light. It's enough.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.dark_0: Not this year. Maybe next, if I'm spared.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.dark_1: I'll just sit with it a while.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.stand_0: Lanternrise is nearly here. Will you walk with me?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.stand_1: The lantern's ready, if you've a candle to spare.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.rumour_0: Someone can't reach the square for Lanternrise.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.rumour_1: Someone on the lane has a lantern and no way there.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.candle_0: A candle! That's all it wanted.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.candle_1: Bless you. Now it will glow.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.lantern.arrive_1: The square! I feared I'd miss it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.ask_0: Two wagons gone, and the band knew which.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.ask_1: Someone is selling the wagons' hours to the band.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.passing: Somebody's talking, and I don't like it.
The band always knew the day. Why is that?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.rumour_: They say the band always knows the wagons' days.
Someone must be telling the band when wagons go.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.plan_0: Let one hear of a wagon. I'll send a decoy.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.plan_1: Whisper a false wagon to one. I'll send a decoy.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.friend_: Not that one. We go back a lifetime.
I'd stake my life on that one.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.tell_0: I see every wagon from my door. I say nothing.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.tell_1: Half the street sees the wagons. Why me?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.tell_fr: I only drink with the sergeant. That's all.
We're old friends. We talk of old days.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.clear_0: Nothing came. Not that one, then.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.clear_1: The road stayed quiet. That one is clear.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.struck_: They were waiting for it. Somebody talked.
The band struck the decoy, just as feared.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.lowlie_: The band is lying low. Try again soon.
Nothing stirred. The band must be resting.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.who_0: Who did you tell? Say it plain.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.who_1: Name the one the band listened to.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.proof_0: That's a heavy word. Bring me proof first.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.proof_1: I'll not shame a neighbour on a hunch.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.named_0: After all these years. After everything.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.named_1: You? Of all the people in this town.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.hush_0: I'll tell the sergeant myself. Give me till dawn.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.hush_1: It stops tonight. I'll face the sergeant myself.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.forgive: I heard it from their own mouth. That counts.
Sit down. It's said, and we'll leave it there.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.road_on: Then I'll watch that road twice over.
Double the guard on that road. I'll see to it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.thanks_: You've done the town a service. I won't forget.
The road's safer for what you did.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.w_0: Another wagon gone. Someone is still talking.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.w_1: The band knew again. I trust no one now.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.stand_0: Any word? Someone is still talking.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.stand_1: Tested or not, the band still listens.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.slip_ok: A wagon is coming? Good to know.
Is that so? I'll keep it quiet.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.caught_: It isn't what it looks like!
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.sorry_0: I'm sorry. I never meant harm.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.informer.sorry_1: They said no one would be hurt.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.ask_0: Something small and dear is gone from my sill.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.ask_1: My locket's gone, and I can't stop looking.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.passing_0: I keep reaching for my throat.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.passing_1: It held a curl of hair. Nothing more.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.rumour_0: They say something was taken from a windowsill.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.rumour_1: Light fingers on the lane, they say.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.sight_sid: I saw someone slip away down the lane at dusk.
Someone hurried off at dusk. I saw which way.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.sight_pie: I never saw a face, only what they wore.
I couldn't tell you who. But I marked their dress.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.sight_chi: A little one waited at the corner, watching.
There was a child by the corner, waiting.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.alibi_0: I was about. Is there harm in that?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.alibi_1: Ask anyone. I was on the lane, that's all.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.wrongly_0: How dare you! I've taken nothing from anyone.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.wrongly_1: You have the wrong door. Shame on you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.read_0: You can see that, just from the sill?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.confess_0: It was me. There was nothing to eat.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.confess_1: I took it. We were so hungry.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.law_0: The Order's law. I can't stand against it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.law_1: Take it. I'll not stand against the Order.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.quiet_0: Take it. Say nothing, I beg you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.quiet_1: Give it back for me. Don't name me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.bread_0: You'd feed me after that? I'll put it right.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.bread_1: Bless you. I'll take it back myself.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.returned_: My locket. Oh, you're home again.
I thought it gone for good. Thank you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.forgive_0: Take a loaf too. We have all been hungry.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.forgive_1: You only had to ask. Come, sit.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.found_0: Found on the lane? Then someone was kind.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.found_1: However it came back, I thank you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.shame_0: I never wanted it done in the street.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.shame_1: It's back, but I'm sorry for the shame.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.lost_0: It's gone, and I've stopped looking now.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.lost_1: Some things don't come back. I know.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.stand_0: Ask the three who saw something. Please.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.locket.stand_1: I only want it back. No one hurt.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.ask_0: My own went down for iron. Two nights now.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.ask_1: They went to the old mine. No word since.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.passing_: The forge feels empty. No word at all.
I keep listening for the door.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.rumour_0: Someone went down the old mine. No sign since.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.rumour_1: They say a delver's missing in the workings.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.captain_: They went out at dusk with a lantern and sack.
I saw them go, toward the old workings.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.choose_0: I can't leave the forge. What would you do?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.choose_1: Go down, send others, or light the way.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.hire_0: Three of us, with torches and rope. For a fee.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.hire_1: We go down at the close. We don't come cheap.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.light_0: Light the old fire by the mine. They'd see it.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.light_1: If they live, they'll climb toward the light.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.thanks_0: You brought them home. I owe you everything.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.thanks_1: I can never repay this. Never.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.cairn_0: Rest easy. I'll keep a lamp lit for you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.cairn_1: At least there is a place to come and speak.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.late_0: Too many nights. No one lives so long below.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.late_1: I knew, and I hoped anyway.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.stand_1: Every hour down there is a bad one.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.paid_0: Done. We go at the close.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.found_0: You came. I thought no one would.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.found_1: My leg. Stay close, they're still about.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.follow_1: Slowly, now. And watch the dark.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.rise_0: The light. I saw the light.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.rise_1: Your fire. I'd almost given up.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.freed_1: The guards are gone. Who did it?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.brother.delver_b: We found them. Hurt, but breathing.
say.guildmark.crier_tale_moot: The moot is called! Come, and say your piece!
say.guildmark.crier_tale_custom: A custom of the town is kept tonight!

message.guildmark.trade.harness.untamed: It has to be tame first.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.not_your: That animal belongs to somebody else.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.busy: Not while it is being ridden.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.failed: The straps will not go on.
message.guildmark.trade.harness.already: It wears a harness already. Sneak to take it off.

message.guildmark.trade.whistle.many_sta: %s pack animals stay where they are.

gui.guildmark.trade.carriers.away: Step up to the hall's counter first.
gui.guildmark.trade.carriers.gone: The counter does not sell that.
gui.guildmark.trade.carriers.failed: That could not be handed over; your Marks are as they were.
ware.guildmark.pack_harness.line: Straps, panniers and a whistle to call by
ware.guildmark.pack_harness.tip: Buckle it on a tame donkey, mule or llama and it follows you carrying your goods, its bell tinkling as it walks. Comes with a Drover's Whistle: blow it to call your animals, sneak and blow it to have them stay.
ware.guildmark.pack_donkey.line: Tame, willing and yours from the click
ware.guildmark.pack_donkey.tip: A donkey that is tame and yours already, brought round from the yard by the town's carter. It comes without a harness.

gui.guildmark.trade.dealer_lot.none: The market would take no ordinary lot of it.

gui.guildmark.trade.haul.tip.kind.relief: Relief: the town has run short of it, so it pays well. For a trader with a Warrant.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.tip.kind.feast: For a feast: wanted by the festival. For a trader with a Warrant.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.tip.pays.mine: Your %s units pay %s when they are in.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.tip.deposit.hel: %s is held as your deposit, and comes back as the goods come in.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.tip.deposit.wou: Booking it holds a deposit of %s, which comes back as the goods come in.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.tip.near: %s of what you carry was bought too near: it doesn't count.

gui.guildmark.trade.haul.tip.deliver: Hand over %s %s that came a long way.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.tip.give_up: Give the ticket up. You keep what you have been paid, but the %s still held as your deposit is lost.

gui.guildmark.trade.haul.refused.gone: That ticket isn't up any more.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.refused.warrant: That ticket is for a trader with a Warrant.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.refused.first_c: A Factor has first call on that ticket for its first day.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.refused.limit: You already hold as many tickets as your rung allows. Fill one or give one up first.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.refused.none: You carry none of what that ticket wants.
gui.guildmark.trade.haul.refused.not_hau: What you carry didn't come far enough: it counts only if you bought it at another market a long way from here (600 blocks by default) within the last ten days.

message.guildmark.trade.haul.delivered.a: %3$s takes %1$s %2$s and pays you %4$s: that's the whole ticket filled.
message.guildmark.trade.haul.deposit_bac: You get %s of your deposit back.
message.guildmark.trade.haul.standing: Your standing as a supplier at %2$s rises by %1$s.

message.guildmark.trade.haul.lapsed.tick: The ticket for %1$s %2$s for %3$s at %4$s has run out of days with %5$s still owing from your booking. The %6$s deposit is lost.
message.guildmark.trade.haul.paid_owed: While you were away your haul tickets paid or returned %s. It is in your pack now.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.lead.some: Someone is seeing to it. Next: %s.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.yes_0: Thank you. That means a great deal.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.hearsay: So the street has it. It may have grown.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.ask_0: I've a small errand and no one to send. Would you?
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.ask_1: Could you spare a hand? It's small, but it matters.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.ask_2: I need a favour, if you're willing. Nothing hard.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.passing_0: If only someone would run an errand for me.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.passing_1: Small jobs pile up when there's no one to send.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.rumour_0: They say someone has an errand and no one to send.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.rumour_1: Word is a neighbour wants a hand with something small.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.stand_1: Let me tell you how it's going.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.chose_1: Good. I'll leave it at that.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.gave_all_0: That's the lot. I can't thank you enough.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.gave_all_1: All of it! You've been a great help.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.short_0: You haven't that many to spare. Keep them.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.short_1: Not so many in your purse, I think. Never mind.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.note_0: Here's the note. Bring me what it asks.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.note_1: Take this. It says what I need.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.lost_0: Lost it? No harm. Here's another.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.lost_1: It happens. Here, a fresh one.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.done_0: That's everything. My thanks to you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.notyet_0: That's not quite it yet. Look at the note again.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.notyet_1: Not yet. The note says what's still wanted.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.late_0: It's late now, but I thank you for trying.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.late_1: Too late for the note, but I'm obliged to you.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.nonote_0: I've no note to give just now. Ask me again.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.nonote_1: Nothing in hand for that. Try once more.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.probe.ask: %1$s would have a reply chosen, %2$s Marks given and a note carried. This step closes %3$s.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.probe.pas: %s has a small errand and no one to send.
say.guildmark.talk.detail.tale.probe.sta: %1$s is waiting for an answer. This step closes %2$s.
A reply is wanted. This step closes %s.
%1$s of %2$s Marks given. This step closes %3$s.
A scene is being staged. This step closes %s.
A day to wait out. This step closes %s.
A note is to be handed in. This step closes %s.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.helper_0: Nothing yet. I'm keeping my eyes open.
say.guildmark.talk.tale.probe.helper_1: Not a word. You'll hear it from me first.
